CALABASAS, Calif., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --

Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: NTHI), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapies for central nervous system cancers, today announced that Amir F. Heshmatpour, its Executive Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer, purchased 80,000 shares of NeOnc common stock on the open market on November 5, 6 and 9, 2026. The purchases totaled $269,082 based on reported prices, at a weighted average of approximately $3.36 per share. Heshmatpour used personal funds, and the Company issued no shares in connection with the transactions.

Heshmatpour has accumulated 271,000 shares through open-market purchases across April, May, August, September and November 2026, based on his SEC Form 4 filings and the brokerage confirmation for his November 9 purchase. He purchased 191,000 of those shares for approximately $688,000 following NeOnc’s August 12 announcement of topline Phase 2a results for intranasal NEO100.

“I’ve invested more than $1 million of my own money in NeOnc shares this year,” said Heshmatpour. “I’ve added to my position repeatedly because I believe in the long-term potential of NEO100 and NEO212 for patients with brain cancer. These purchases deepen my personal investment alongside our shareholders.”

In the single-arm Phase 2a study of intranasal NEO100 in recurrent IDH1-mutant high-grade glioma, six-month progression-free survival was 48.9% against a prespecified 20% benchmark (p = 0.0047). Median overall survival was 26.1 months. NEO212 has completed Phase 1 dose escalation and established a recommended Phase 2 dose. NeOnc is scheduled to present data from both programs at the Society for Neuro-Oncology Annual Meeting on November 13. In October, NeOnc signed a memorandum of understanding with the Department of Health – Abu Dhabi to advance brain cancer research and explore clinical trial opportunities in the emirate, including in pediatric oncology.
About NeOnc Technologies Holdings, Inc.

NeOnc Technologies Holdings, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapies for central nervous system cancers. Its investigational programs include intranasal NEO100 and oral NEO212. NEO212 has completed Phase 1 dose escalation and is advancing toward Phase 2 development. NeOnc exclusively licenses a worldwide portfolio of issued patents and pending applications from the University of Southern California related to NEO100, NEO212 and other drug candidates and delivery approaches. For more information, visit https://neonc.com.
